comment: The membership object every host reads and any process writes by compare-and-set (membership.Store), and a process's copy of it (membership.Source, the View), which reads the object again when a peer names a newer generation. Both reach the object store through platform.ObjectStore; the store's own sites fail a read, fail a write and lose a write's reply (membership/store.go). The cloud's disks the shard controller attaches and detaches are platform.NetworkDisks, the platform's manifest. See scripts/check-faults.py.

faults.purpose: the store is down: a view keeps the generation it holds and a writer tries again
nothing was written: the update fails and is made again
the store refused the write before applying it: the update fails and is made again from what the store holds
the write landed and its reply did not: the writer finds its own write by its nonce and does not write it twice
as for Update: the controller's pass fails and the next pass takes the step

faults.none: the membership the view holds in this process

faults.purpose: a holder behind a request could not read the newer membership: it answers stale with its own generation and never asks its cache
